correctness.rationale: From B_{t+1}={x: exists y successor of x with R(y) subset B_t}, monotonically increasing failure sets are well defined. A rank-t point forces t distinct finite-rank x_j and t distinct never-failing y_j on an alternating directed path terminating at a dead end. Hence n>=2t and alpha_floor(n/2)=alpha_floor(n/2)+1. A 2t-vertex path attains t; n=1 stabilizes at zero. The finite checker is corroborative, not an all-size proof.
